articles.title: Somatotopy-independent reduction of audio-tactile intersensory facilitation for looming sounds within the peripersonal space during arm movements execution
articles.summary: This neuroscience research by Serino examines Peripersonal Space (PPS), conceptualized as a crucial multisensory interface between an individual and their environment. PPS defines our 'self-space,' impacting how we perceive and interact with our immediate surroundings. Understanding this fundamental aspect of brain function, particularly concerning spatial awareness and reactions to external stimuli, holds relevance for developing sharper observational skills and effective operational responses.
